steps.en: A wrongly formatted search value shows an error
steps.id: Nilai pencarian berformat salah menampilkan error
steps.why_en: Only format checks exist; a well-formed but unknown notice number gets no error at the search step.
steps.why_id: Hanya cek format; notice number berformat benar tapi tidak ada tidak memicu error di tahap pencarian.

steps.en: An error appears when the notice is paid
steps.id: Muncul error jika notice sudah dibayar
steps.why_en: The paid message comes only when applying a reduction, not at the search step.
steps.why_id: Pesan paid hanya muncul saat reduction diterapkan, bukan di tahap pencarian.

steps.en: An error appears when the notice is cancelled
steps.why_en: No cancelled message exists, and a cancelled notice is not blocked when a reduction is applied.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pesan cancelled, dan notice cancelled tidak diblokir saat reduction diterapkan.

steps.en: An error appears for unknown or ineligible notices
steps.id: Muncul error untuk notice tidak ada atau tidak eligible
steps.why_en: The messages exist only when a reduction is applied, not when searching.
steps.why_id: Pesan hanya ada saat reduction diterapkan, bukan saat mencari.

steps.en: A message appears when no notice applies
steps.id: Muncul pesan jika tidak ada notice yang berlaku
steps.why_en: Only a generic empty-list text appears, without saying why nothing was found.
steps.why_id: Hanya teks daftar kosong yang umum, tanpa menjelaskan alasannya.
